title: Staying Far Enough From a Person: The Protective Separation Distance, the Speed It Allows, and What Each Term Is For

artifact.note: speed and separation monitoring in the form that ISO 13855 and ISO/TS 15066 use, modelled and not certified: the protective separation distance as the sum of the distance a person covers during the reaction and stopping times, the distance the robot covers during the reaction time, the robot's stopping distance, an intrusion distance and the measurement uncertainties; the greatest robot speed that a given separation allows (the inverse); and a one dimensional simulation of a person walking at the robot, to show that the distance is enough, and that leaving out a term makes it not enough
